workforce.title: Workforce Analytics
workforce.description: How many people are in each organizational unit and under each position title, in your scope.

stats.totalDesc: People in your scope. Technical accounts (agents, test) are not counted.
stats.ouDesc: Units with at least one person
stats.rolesDesc: Distinct titles among the people in the workforce (not access roles)

workforce.roleEmptyDesc: There are no people with a position in your scope.
workforce.emptyDesc: There is no workforce data within your scope at the moment.

kpi.title: Indicator analysis
kpi.description: How close the results achieved are to the targets, for the indicators (KPIs) that have a measured result, in your scope.
kpi.gaugeLabel: Average achievement of the measured indicators
kpi.nullNote: {{count}} indicators have no measured result yet: they are not in the chart and not in the average.
kpi.nullNote_one: {{count}} indicator has no measured result yet: it is not in the chart and not in the average.
kpi.emptyDesc: There are no KPI targets within your scope at the moment.
kpi.measuredNote: The average covers {{measured}} indicators out of {{total}}: the only ones with a measured result.

attendance.title: Attendance Analytics
attendance.description: Worked hours (regular and overtime) by month and organizational unit within your scope.
attendance.monthlyNote: Linear vertical axis in hours; monthly spikes (bulk imports) stay at real scale.
attendance.ouEmptyDesc: There are no hours recorded by organizational unit within your scope.
attendance.emptyDesc: There is no attendance recorded within your scope at the moment.

compensation.title: Compensation Analytics
compensation.description: Distribution of pay bands (€) by organizational unit and position equity within your scope.
compensation.boxplotTitle: Distribution of pay bands per unit (midpoint, €)
compensation.scatterTitle: Positioning: band midpoint and band width
compensation.scatterAria: Pay positioning: band midpoint and band width
compensation.scatterNote: Each point is a position with a band; the color indicates the organizational unit.
compensation.emptyDesc: There are no compensation profiles with a band within your scope at the moment.
compensation.scopeNote: Top-level units that your access level cannot read are excluded: the number of units and the figures can therefore be smaller than those of the workforce.

skills.title: Skills Coverage
skills.description: Distribution of declared skill evidence by organizational unit and proficiency level within your scope.

stats.usersDesc: People with at least one evidence

skills.heatmapTitle: Coverage by unit and proficiency level
skills.heatmapAria: Skills coverage by organizational unit and proficiency level
skills.heatmapNote: Coverage of declared evidence (not a skills-vs-requirements gap: the per-position skill requirements are not populated yet).
skills.emptyDesc: There is no skill evidence within your scope at the moment.

skillsByCategory.title: Skills by Category
skillsByCategory.description: Distribution of declared skill evidence by skill category and proficiency level within your scope.

stats.usersDesc: People with at least one evidence

skillsByCategory.heatmapTitle: Coverage by category and proficiency level
skillsByCategory.heatmapAria: Skills coverage by category and proficiency level
skillsByCategory.heatmapNote: Coverage of declared evidence broken down by skill category (not a skills-vs-requirements gap: the per-position skill requirements are not populated yet).
skillsByCategory.emptyDesc: There is no skill evidence within your scope at the moment.

skillsGroupShare.title: Skill shares per group (ESCO classification)
skillsGroupShare.description: How the skills held by the company's people are spread across the groups of the European skills classification (ESCO). Platform managers see the whole catalogue.

stats.ungroupedDesc: Skills not yet mapped to a group

skillsGroupShare.chartAria: Number of skills per ESCO group
skillsGroupShare.chartNote: Top {{n}} of {{total}} groups; the rest are folded into “other”. Share is computed over the grouped skills.
skillsGroupShare.emptyDesc: The skill catalogue has no ESCO groups populated yet.

orgNetwork.title: Org Network
orgNetwork.description: How the active positions are linked: who reports to whom, how many levels there are below the top, and how many positions depend on each manager.
orgNetwork.guida: A position is a seat in the organisation; a person holds it. The numbers count active positions only (filled or vacant), so they can differ from the number of people.

stats.positionsDesc: Seats in the organisation today, filled or vacant
stats.rootsDesc: Positions that report to no one: normally just one, the General Manager
stats.managersDesc: Positions that at least one other position reports to
stats.spanDesc: How many positions report, on average, directly to each manager
stats.depthDesc: The most steps from the top to the farthest position

orgNetwork.depthTitle: How many positions there are at each level
orgNetwork.depthAria: Number of positions at each level below the top
orgNetwork.depthNote: Level 0 is the top; level 1 are the positions reporting directly to the top, level 2 those reporting to them, and so on. The bars add up to all active positions ({{totale}}).
orgNetwork.spanTitle: Who has the most direct reports (top 15)
orgNetwork.spanAria: Managers with the most positions reporting directly to them
orgNetwork.spanNote: For each manager, how many positions report directly to them (in English, the «span of control»): a high number means many people to follow first-hand.
orgNetwork.reachTitle: How many positions depend on each manager across the whole chain (top 15)
orgNetwork.reachAria: Managers with the most positions below them
orgNetwork.reachNote: Counts every position below a manager, directly or through other managers. The top has every other position below it ({{n}}).
orgNetwork.spanEmptyDesc: There are no positions with direct reports within your scope.
orgNetwork.emptyDesc: There are no positions in the org graph within your scope at the moment.

overtime.title: Overtime Requests
overtime.description: Overtime request and approval lifecycle by status, type, month and organizational unit within your scope.

stats.compDesc: Estimated pay of the requests, excluding rejected or cancelled ones
stats.compUnavailableDesc: No request in your scope carries an amount.

overtime.monthlyNote: Overtime requests and the hours recorded in attendance (see Attendance analysis) are the same hours seen from two sources: do not add them up.
overtime.ouAria: Overtime hours requested by organizational unit
overtime.ouEmptyDesc: There are no overtime requests by organizational unit within your scope.
overtime.emptyDesc: There are no overtime requests within your scope at the moment.

skillsGraph.title: Skill graph
skillsGraph.description: The neighbourhood of a skill: declared links between skills plus membership in the ESCO taxonomy. You always start from one skill — the whole catalogue holds over 18,000 edges, and drawing all of it would not be a view.
skillsGraph.pickDescription: Search a skill above and select it: the graph will show its neighbourhood.
skillsGraph.canvasEmpty: No links for this skill at this depth.

charts.tableTitle: Show the data as a table
